title: ClusterPolicies are no longer enforced — Kyverno 1.20 does not run legacy kyverno.io policies
quote: Kyverno v1.20 no longer executes the deprecated `ClusterPolicy`, `Policy`, `CleanupPolicy`, `ClusterCleanupPolicy`, or legacy `kyverno.io` `PolicyException` types.
remediation: Migrate every legacy policy to the `policies.kyverno.io` types before upgrading (validate → ValidatingPolicy, mutate → MutatingPolicy, generate → GeneratingPolicy, verifyImages → ImageValidatingPolicy, cleanup → DeletingPolicy, PolicyException → policies.kyverno.io PolicyException). 1.20 keeps the objects but does not run them, and: (1) `helm upgrade` is blocked by the chart's legacy-policy gate until they are gone or you set `upgrade.acknowledgeLegacyPoliciesNotEnforced=true` — it counts all five kinds, so even an exception or a cleanup policy blocks it (a live-cluster `lookup` check at render time plus a pre-upgrade hook Job; `--no-hooks`, Argo CD Skip Hooks and Flux disableHooks skip only the Job, while `helm template`, client-side `--dry-run` and the static release manifests skip both); (2) every create and update of these kinds is denied — a GitOps tool that re-applies them reports them permanently out of sync, so delete the legacy manifests from Git once migrated; (3) YAML installs mark them NotReady. Back them up before an uninstall/reinstall: deleting a CRD deletes its objects. The CRDs themselves are planned for removal in 1.21.
verifyCommand: kubectl get clusterpolicies.kyverno.io,policies.kyverno.io,cleanuppolicies.kyverno.io,clustercleanuppolicies.kyverno.io,policyexceptions.kyverno.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row is a legacy object 1.20 stops running
coversNotes: Install or upgrade with YAML manifests
Blog: CEL policy types are now the only engine
Blog: What's next (Full removal of the legacy policy)
v1.20.0 What's Changed: feat: block creates and spec-updates of legacy policy
v1.20.0 What's Changed: feat(helm): add required default-on gate for legacy policy
v1.20.0 What's Changed: feat: reject legacy policy writes without typed policy
v1.20.0 What's Changed: feat: remove legacy policy execution from the background
v1.20.0 What's Changed: feat: remove legacy policy evaluation from the reports

title: `--maxAuditWorkers` / `--maxAuditCapacity` are removed from the admission controller

detection.reason: checked in the container args of the Kyverno Deployments (admission controller) — a flag passed any other way is not scanned

quote: feat: remove legacy policy execution from admission binaries
remediation: Remove `--maxAuditWorkers` / `--maxAuditCapacity` from the admission controller's extra args (v1.19.2 cmd/kyverno/main.go, gone in v1.20.0 with #18164); an unknown flag stops the container at start, and the chart no longer renders them.
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(any(.spec.template.spec.containers[]; .image | test("(^|/)kyverno/(kyverno|background-controller|cleanup-controller|reports-controller)([:@]|$)"))) | select(any(.spec.template.spec.containers[].args[]?; test("^--?maxAudit(Workers|Capacity)(=|$)"))) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row passes a removed flag

title: GlobalContextEntry JMESPath projections are deprecated — use the CEL `expression` field

detection.reason: read from whether each GlobalContextEntry has a JMESPath projection

remediation: Rewrite each projection of the GlobalContextEntries named with the CEL `expression` field.
verifyCommand: kubectl get globalcontextentries.kyverno.io -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(any(.spec.projections[]?; .jmesPath != null)) | .metadata.name'  # each row uses a JMESPath projection

title: An ImageValidatingPolicy without `matchConstraints` is refused
quote: fix(ivpol): reject ImageValidatingPolicy with empty matchConstraints
remediation: Add `matchConstraints` to every ImageValidatingPolicy that has none (#17162 makes it required); without it the next apply is refused.
verifyCommand: kubectl get imagevalidatingpolicies.policies.kyverno.io -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.matchConstraints == null) | .metadata.name'  # each row has no matchConstraints

title: The kyverno-policies chart renders only ValidatingPolicies — `policyType` and the ClusterPolicy-only values are removed
quote: Removed the policyType chart value; the built-in PSS templates now render only ValidatingPolicy (policies.kyverno.io) types
remediation: If you kept the kyverno-policies (Pod Security Standards) chart on `policyType: ClusterPolicy`, 1.20 ignores it: the chart installs ValidatingPolicies and the PSS ClusterPolicies listed are removed with the upgrade. The values `policyKind`, `policyType`, `validationFailureActionOverrides`, `validationAllowExistingViolations`, `policyExclude`, `policyPreconditions`, `autogenControllers`, `background` and `skipBackgroundRequests` no longer exist — move exclusions to `vpolExclude` / `vpolExcludeByPolicy` before upgrading or they stop applying. Autogen for pod controllers stays on unless an exclusion sets `excludeResourceRules`, which makes that policy Pod-only.
verifyCommand: helm list -A -o json | jq -r '.[] | select(.chart | test("^kyverno-policies-")) | "\(.namespace)/\(.name) \(.chart) app \(.app_version)"'  # each row is a Kyverno Helm release; read its values with: helm get values NAME -n NAMESPACE
coversNotes: v1.20.0 What's Changed: fix(chart): drop the changelog entry for the removed

title: A NamespacedImageValidatingPolicy resolves registry credentials in its own namespace only
quote: fix: scope namespaced image policy credentials by namespace
remediation: `spec.credentials.secrets` and attestor signature pull secrets (`spec.attestors[].cosign.source.PullSecrets`) of a NamespacedImageValidatingPolicy are looked up in the policy's namespace; a reference to a Secret in another namespace (the Kyverno namespace included) is refused at admission and at runtime. Provision tenant credentials in the policy's namespace and grant Kyverno `get` on exactly those Secrets BEFORE upgrading: a Secret the controller is denied fails credential resolution outright, so the policy errors on every matching image, not only private ones. Or move the policy to a cluster-scoped ImageValidatingPolicy.
verifyCommand: kubectl get $(kubectl api-resources --api-group=policies.kyverno.io -o name | grep -E '^namespacedimagevalidatingpolic' | paste -sd, -) -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | ([.spec.credentials.secrets[]?] + [.spec.attestors[]?.cosign.source.PullSecrets[]?.name]) as $s | select($s[0] != null) | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name) secrets=\($s | join(","))"'  # each row is a namespaced image policy and the Secret names it references (names only)

title: The legacy engine's metrics are gone — dashboards and alerts on `kyverno_policy_results` read nothing

detection.reason: dashboards and alert rules are not collected

quote: feat: delete the legacy kyverno.io policy engine
remediation: 1.20 stops emitting `kyverno_policy_results`, `kyverno_policy_rule_info_total`, `kyverno_policy_changes`, `kyverno_policy_execution_duration_seconds`, `kyverno_cleanup_controller_deletedobjects` and `kyverno_cleanup_controller_errors`. An alert on them never fires again. Repoint dashboards and alerts to the per-type series `kyverno_{validating,mutating,generating,image_validating}_policy_results` and `..._policy_execution_duration_seconds`, and drop the removed entries from `metricsConfig.metricsExposure`.
verifyCommand: kubectl get prometheusrules.monitoring.coreos.com -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(tostring | test("kyverno_policy_(results|rule_info_total|changes|execution_duration_seconds)|kyverno_cleanup_controller_(deletedobjects|errors)")) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row is a PrometheusRule that reads a metric 1.20 no longer emits

title: DeletingPolicies skip resources excluded by `resourceFilters`

detection.reason: the resourceFilters value of the kyverno ConfigMap is not collected

quote: fix(controllers): honor resourceFilters in cleanup and deleting controllers
remediation: The deleting controller passed the resource's kind where the subresource belongs, so only `[Kind/?*,...]` entries of the `kyverno` ConfigMap's `resourceFilters` matched (Node, APIService, ReplicaSet were already skipped that way). From 1.20 the plain `[Kind,...]` entries apply too: in the chart default that newly skips `Event`, `Binding`, `(Cluster)EphemeralReport` and Kyverno's own ClusterRoles / bindings, plus any kind-only entry you added. A DeletingPolicy that prunes old Events silently stops doing so. Compare the kinds each DeletingPolicy matches with the filter list and remove the entry (`config.resourceFilters` / `config.resourceFiltersExclude`) for kinds you do want deleted.
verifyCommand: kubectl get cm -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name == "kyverno" and (.data | has("resourceFilters"))) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/kyverno \(.data.resourceFilters)"' ; kubectl get $(kubectl api-resources --api-group=policies.kyverno.io -o name | grep -E 'deletingpolic' | paste -sd, -) -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name) \([.spec.matchConstraints.resourceRules[]?.resources[]?] | join(","))"'  # first block: the resource filters in force; second block: each DeletingPolicy and the resources it matches

title: The chart's Pod Security Standards policies are stricter (drop ALL, runAsNonRoot, host probes)

detection.reason: which PSS policies the chart installs is a Helm value

quote: fix(charts): enforce drop ALL and deny pod-level runAsNonRoot=false in PSS CEL policies
remediation: If you install the chart's PSS policies, re-test workloads against them: Restricted now requires `capabilities.drop: [ALL]` and refuses pod-level `runAsNonRoot: false`, and Baseline adds disallow-host-probes.
coversNotes: v1.20.0 What's Changed: feat(charts): add disallow-host-probes Baseline PSS policy by @Suhani95
